Is my Astryx code good?
Check whether a product surface fits its app and uses Astryx well, require evidence for every claim, and improve it with
a repeatable agent review.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

understand-the-app    Understand the app - Do not judge a file or surface in isolation. First learn the app context that
                      makes a pattern correct, inconsistent, or incomplete.
choose-the-review     Choose the review - Review one exact revision and one named product surface, route, or component
                      in its app context. Pick the smallest review that can answer your question.
apply-the-rubric      Apply the shared rubric - Mark each category `good`, `needs work`, or `not inspected`. Cite the
                      route, sibling surface, project guidance, theme, component catalog, or user requirement behind
                      every context-dependent result; cite a file and line for every source...
collect-the-evidence  Collect the evidence - Record the exact revision, named surface, route, and source files in scope.
                      If the files are outside version control, record a content hash for each file and say that no
                      project revision was available.
ask-an-agent          Ask an agent - Start with a read-only pass so the original findings stay visible. Replace every
                      angle-bracket value in this prompt.
verify-and-repeat     Verify, improve, and repeat - Reject a `good` result without app-context, source, and rendered
                      evidence. Open every cited route, sibling file, guidance file, and source location, and reproduce
                      every named visible state.

Read one section: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs is-my-code-good <section>
